howto: Your runner slides between 3 neon lanes.
Swipe left or right, tap either half of the screen, or press the arrow keys to change lane.
Barriers, spikes and wide blocks fall towards you: be in another lane when they arrive.
Every obstacle that passes scores 1. Survive 30 seconds.
tips: The fall speeds up the longer you last, so move early.
A swipe changes lane without waiting for your finger to lift.
Wide blocks cover more of a lane than they look.
Hint names the safest lane right now.

controls.keyboard: Left / Right arrows (or A / D) change lane; Space starts. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe left or right, or tap the side you want to move to. Pause button top left.

difficulty: Easy starts slower with more space between obstacles; Hard starts faster and packs them in. Every run speeds up over time.

cheats.effect: Your runner shrinks to half size, so tight gaps fit

features.one-tap-start: Tap, Space or an arrow key on the title card
features.instant-restart: Tap once on the CRASHED! or SURVIVED! card
features.tutorial-card: First-run How to play card with an animated swipe; replay from Pause > How to play
features.results: CRASHED! / SURVIVED! card with obstacles dodged and best
